title: Ahaziah becomes king of Judah
description: The chapter tells about King Jehoram of Judah, son of Jehoshaphat, who walked in the ways of Ahab's house because he was married to Ahab's daughter. In his days Edom and Libnah revolted from Judah's rule. After Jehoram's death, his son Ahaziah became king of Judah. Ahaziah's mother was Athaliah, granddaughter of Omri. Ahaziah went with Jehoram of Israel to war against Hazael, king of Aram, at Ramoth in Gilead, where Jehoram was wounded. Ahaziah then went down to Jezreel to visit the sick Jehoram.
